variations.name: contemporary themed oracle decks

feasibility.first_scope: One named source-grounded Lenormand36 deck,all36 verified meanings and a small documented reading layout;copyright/primary-page access is the first gate,not a generic empty schema.
feasibility.alternative: If ranked procedural access cannot be obtained promptly,a separately registered legitimate historical/public-domain source may be researched without changing inventory rankings;not done in this audit.
feasibility.card_inventory: Canonical IDs and order must be frozen per edition;36-card Lenormand/Kipper,52-card named Wisdom/Sibilla and53-card current Belline leads are distinct. Do not copy Tarot78 or assume common suits/courts.
feasibility.source_meanings: Direct per-card procedures,conditions and combinations must come from inspected source pages;marketing/small preview captions do not supply a complete reusable meaning table.
feasibility.spreads: Verify source position order,direction,adjacency,significators and exceptions. Kipper publisher names layouts but full procedure still unverified. Do not silently reuse Tarot Celtic or call editorial three positions a historical spread.
feasibility.orientations: Deck/edition-defined policy unresolved until procedure is inspected. Tarot upright/reversed meanings and random orientation policy do not automatically apply.
feasibility.rights: All current sources/decks are metadata only;book,guidebook,art,translation and edition rights reviewed separately. Text-only implementation may reduce art dependencies but is not permission to ingest a copyrighted dictionary.

reusable_infrastructure.reusable: Strict UTF-8 seed framing,independent streams,unbiased integer selection and shuffle_pack operate on supplied distinct IDs;reuse verified byte protocol without changing Tarot behavior.
reusable_infrastructure.must_not_reuse: Tarot catalog,78-card order,suits,courts,meanings,Celtic layout,three-cut policy or reversal semantics.
reusable_infrastructure.constraints: Current orientation helper validates count<=78;do not assume all contemporary decks fit. Deck-specific eligibility/count/orientation policy and source-certified canonical order must be established before any wrapper.
reusable_infrastructure.replay: Record deck/profile/version,exact canonical IDs/hash,draw policy,count,seed,protocol and any source-specific transformations;same seed alone is not a complete Oracle reading.
reusable_infrastructure.tests: Independent known-answer vectors over each selected deck order;no replacement,draw-count boundaries,manual/source isolation and cross-profile reproducibility

P1: Legitimate rank1 procedural pages/edition and rights verification
One complete36-card source dictionary with independently transcribed fixtures
One verified simple spread and explicit orientation/direction policy
Freeze deck-specific replay/input contract and supported/unsupported scope before implementation
P2: Separate Kipper,Belline,Sibilla and contemporary profiles after complete source access
Additional combinations,Grand Tableaux,direction/proximity and source exceptions
Separately licensed or verified public-domain imagery
limitations: Deck facts and source leads only. Promotional spiritual/predictive claims are not validation. No universal meanings,reversal probabilities or empirical accuracy claims. Original60-technique taxonomy,54 retained methods,rankings and exclusions25,27,41,42,47,48 unchanged.
